name: nonApi_deleteChatMessage
description: Internal (no auth of its own). Removes one chat message for everyone (E9.F1.S13/S14) — the rule lives HERE, once; HC6.hcapp_deleteChatMessage and HC6.hcportal_deleteChatMessage only authenticate and shape the reply, and publicWeb_deleteChatMessage wraps the app SP. Allowed when @userId WROTE the message, or moderates its thread (HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat: moderateChat in the kennel, SuperAdmin for rooms). A soft delete (HC.EventMessage.Removed = 1): every reader filters it out and returns it in its {removedId} rowset. Deleting a message that is already gone succeeds (outcome 1). A moderator removing someone ELSE's message writes a LOG.GeneralLog line carrying the removed text — the only record left of what was said and who took it down. Outcomes via OUTPUT: 1 removed (or already was), 2 not found, 3 not allowed; @errorId is the HC.ErrorLog row for 2 and 3. A moderator deleting someone else's message in a kennel's Mismanagement chat must also be in HC6.UserInKennelMismanagement (2026-10-16, E9.F1.S33).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The hasher asking (already authenticated by the caller).

parameters.name: callerProcName
parameters.description: The wrapping SP's name, written as ProcName in HC.ErrorLog and in the audit line ('via=').

parameters.name: hcVersion
parameters.description: The caller's HC version string for HC.ErrorLog.HcVersion.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: OUTPUT. 1 removed (or already removed), 2 not found, 3 not allowed. Initialised to 2.

parameters.name: errorId
parameters.description: OUTPUT. The HC.ErrorLog id written for outcome 2 or 3; NULL for outcome 1.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.EventMessage SET Removed = 1, updatedAt WHERE id = @messageId AND Removed = 0 (in a transaction). HC.trgEventMessageActivityCount keeps HC.Event.MessageCount in step, so the run card's chat count follows.
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog ('Chat message removed by a moderator', with message, author, event/kennel/thread/room, via, and up to 4000 chars of the text) when the remover is not the author.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('Chat message not found' / 'Not allowed to delete chat message', ProcName = @callerProcName) for outcomes 2 and 3; CATCH rolls back, logs and THROWs.
EXEC HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat when the remover is not the author.

codeSmells.detail: All six parameters (lines 2-7) have no SQL default. The callers are SPs that always pass them, so no client can trigger the unlogged 500, but a new caller omitting @hcVersion or @callerProcName fails before the body runs.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
